name: cio_desk_resistance_label_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CIO_DESK_RESISTANCE_LABEL_20261107 — ticker_prices is a daily CLOSE store, so portfolio_repricer.close_session_date stamps the session the price in hand belongs to (never CURRENT_DATE: the all-day */15 cron wrote a Saturday row holding Friday's close), the CIO subject brief drops bars dated to a non-session, and a level the price holds above reads as a broken breakout floor rather than overhead resistance.
